specs.Item Type Name: Type C to Type C cables

features: Type: The ZEB-TT60+ is a type-C to type-C charging cable
Capacity: This charger has a rapid charging capacity as it can power up your device up to 60W and 3A
Cable length: The cable is 1 meter long and can give a tangle-free charging experience with tough braiding potential
Durability: It has supreme durability, with reinforced connectors, and this strong cable can accommodate a wide range of devices for data transfer between laptops, smartphones/tablets
Compatibility: This charging cable can support Type-C PD adapters. Suitable for Smartphones, Tablets & Laptops (depending upon compatible models)
description: ZEBRONICS Type C to Type C Strong Braided Cable, 60W PD Fast Charging, for iPhone 16 Series, 15 Series, iPad, MacBook, Samsung, Other Android Devices, Data Sync, 1 Meter (ZEB-TT60+) White
